theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {s t : Finset α} : s ⋖ t → s.val ⋖ t.val := by
  intro h
  have h_subset : s ⊆ t := by exact h.2
  have h_val_subset : s.val ⊆ t.val := by
    rw [subset_def]
    intro x
    intro h_x_in_s
    apply Finset.mem_val_of_mem h_x_in_s
  exact ⟨h_subset, h_val_subset⟩
